exposure: Availability of data (anthropometrics, blood glucose, gestational age, urinalysis, lipid profile)
outcome: Barriers to GDM diagnosis and postpartum follow-up
cohort: The study reviewed records and procedures of antenatal services for pregnant women at two hospitals.
finding: Critical barriers to GDM diagnosis and postpartum follow-up, including lack of routine blood sugar screening and GDM registers, were identified in health systems, leading to undiagnosed GDM and lack of follow-up for positive glucosuria cases.
gest_age: Data on gestational age were reviewed in patient records.
